premise: Rabbit's big ears hear his friends whispering about a birthday surprise for him, so he pretends he heard nothing all day — and gives them the most surprised face in the forest.
inspiration: The Emperor's New Clothes (Andersen), turned: here pretending not to know is the kind thing, and the secret stays safe with a friend.
lesson: Sometimes the kind thing is to let friends surprise you.

en-US.title: Rabbit Hears a Surprise
en-US.text: {rabbit:enter} Rabbit had the biggest ears in the meadow. One morning, {rabbit:face surprised} {rabbit:live listen hold} they shot straight up. Far across the grass, someone was whispering. [whispers] "Shh! A birthday surprise for Rabbit, this afternoon. Don't tell!" A surprise? For HIM? Rabbit could have shouted, "I heard you!" But he didn't. {rabbit:live listen resume} He just nibbled his clover. All day, his friends acted very funny. {squirrel:enter} {squirrel:go to rabbit} Squirrel bounded by and {squirrel:live hide-nut hold} hid something behind her back, looking ever so innocent. {bee:enter} {bee:go to rabbit} {sfx:buzz} Bee buzzed past, {bee:face surprised} {bee:shake} saw Rabbit… and {bee:go away} zoomed off, giggling. [giggles] {rabbit:face happy} Rabbit didn't say a word. That afternoon, {raccoon:enter} {raccoon:go to rabbit} Raccoon came creeping up. {raccoon:face happy} {raccoon:live peekaboo} He hid his eyes… peeked… {canvas:confetti} {sfx:popper} [excited] "SURPRISE!" {bee:go back} {rabbit:face surprised} {rabbit:hop x3} [gasps] "For ME?" cried Rabbit, with the most surprised face in the forest. {all:face happy} {bee:go to rabbit} {squirrel:live hide-nut resume} Out came Squirrel's present: her very best hazelnut. {bee:live hum} And Bee hummed a birthday tune. {rabbit:tint #FFC0D0} [playfully] Rabbit's big ears turned pink. Those ears had heard everything. But they never told.

es-ES.title: Las orejas de Conejo
es-ES.text: {rabbit:enter} Conejo tenía las orejas más grandes del prado. Una mañana, {rabbit:face surprised} {rabbit:live listen hold} se le pusieron de punta. A lo lejos, alguien cuchicheaba. [whispers] —¡Chsss! Esta tarde, sorpresa de cumpleaños para Conejo. ¡No se lo digáis! ¿Una sorpresa? ¿Para ÉL? Podría haber gritado «¡Os he oído!». Pero no lo hizo. {rabbit:live listen resume} Siguió mordisqueando su trébol. Todo el día, sus amigos estuvieron rarísimos. {squirrel:enter} {squirrel:go to rabbit} Ardilla pasó dando brincos y {squirrel:live hide-nut hold} escondió algo detrás de la espalda, con cara de no haber roto un plato. {bee:enter} {bee:go to rabbit} {sfx:buzz} Abeja pasó zumbando, {bee:face surprised} {bee:shake} vio a Conejo… y {bee:go away} salió disparada entre risitas. [giggles] {rabbit:face happy} Conejo no dijo ni pío. Por la tarde, {raccoon:enter} {raccoon:go to rabbit} Mapache se acercó de puntillas. {raccoon:face happy} {raccoon:live peekaboo} Se tapó los ojos… espió… {canvas:confetti} {sfx:popper} [excited] —¡SORPRESA! {bee:go back} {rabbit:face surprised} {rabbit:hop x3} [gasps] —¿Para MÍ? —exclamó Conejo, con la cara más sorprendida del bosque. {all:face happy} {bee:go to rabbit} {squirrel:live hide-nut resume} Ardilla sacó su regalo: su mejor avellana. {bee:live hum} Y Abeja le tarareó una canción de cumpleaños. {rabbit:tint #FFC0D0} [playfully] A Conejo se le pusieron las orejas coloradas. Esas orejas lo habían oído todo. Pero nunca dijeron nada.

ja-JP.title: ウサギくんの ないしょの耳
ja-JP.text: {rabbit:enter}ウサギくんの耳は、のはらでいちばん大きな耳。あるあさ、{rabbit:face surprised}{rabbit:live listen hold}その耳が、ぴーん！とおくで、ひそひそごえ。[whispers]「しーっ！ごごから、ウサギくんのおたんじょうびの、びっくりパーティー。ないしょだよ！」 びっくり？ぼくに？「きこえたよ！」 ってさけびたいけど…ウサギくんはだまって、{rabbit:live listen resume}クローバーをもぐもぐ。その日は、みんながなんだかへん。{squirrel:enter}{squirrel:go to rabbit}リスさんは、とおりかかると{squirrel:live hide-nut hold}なにかをせなかにかくして、しらんぷり。{bee:enter}{bee:go to rabbit}{sfx:buzz}ミツバチさんは、ぶーんときて、{bee:face surprised}{bee:shake}ウサギくんを見ると…{bee:go away}くすくすとんでいっちゃった。[giggles]{rabbit:face happy}ウサギくんは、なんにもいいません。ごごになると、{raccoon:enter}{raccoon:go to rabbit}アライグマくんが、そろりそろり。{raccoon:face happy}{raccoon:live peekaboo}目をかくして…ちらっ…{canvas:confetti}{sfx:popper}[excited]「じゃじゃーん！おめでとう！」 {bee:go back}{rabbit:face surprised}{rabbit:hop x3}[gasps]「ぼくに？」 森でいちばんの、びっくりがお。{all:face happy}{bee:go to rabbit}{squirrel:live hide-nut resume}リスさんのプレゼントは、とっておきの木の実。{bee:live hum}ミツバチさんは、おたんじょうびのうたを、ふんふーん。{rabbit:tint #FFC0D0}[playfully]ウサギくんの大きな耳が、ぽっとピンクに。あの耳は、ぜんぶきいていました。でも、だれにもいわなかったのです。

de-DE.title: Die großen Ohren des Hasen
de-DE.text: {rabbit:enter} Der Hase hatte die größten Ohren auf der ganzen Wiese. Eines Morgens {rabbit:face surprised} {rabbit:live listen hold} schossen sie kerzengerade in die Höhe. Weit drüben im Gras flüsterte jemand. [whispers] „Pssst! Heute Nachmittag hat der Hase Geburtstag – das wird eine Überraschung! Nicht verraten!“ Eine Überraschung? Für IHN? Der Hase hätte rufen können: „Ich hab’s gehört!“ Aber das tat er nicht. {rabbit:live listen resume} Er knabberte einfach weiter an seinem Klee. Den ganzen Tag benahmen sich seine Freunde ziemlich komisch. {squirrel:enter} {squirrel:go to rabbit} Das Eichhörnchen sprang vorbei und {squirrel:live hide-nut hold} versteckte etwas hinter dem Rücken, mit ganz unschuldigem Gesicht. {bee:enter} {bee:go to rabbit} {sfx:buzz} Die Biene summte heran, {bee:face surprised} {bee:shake} sah den Hasen… und {bee:go away} sauste kichernd davon. [giggles] {rabbit:face happy} Der Hase sagte keinen Pieps. Am Nachmittag schlich sich {raccoon:enter} {raccoon:go to rabbit} der Waschbär heran. {raccoon:face happy} {raccoon:live peekaboo} Er hielt sich die Augen zu… lugte hervor… {canvas:confetti} {sfx:popper} [excited] „ÜBERRASCHUNG!“ {bee:go back} {rabbit:face surprised} {rabbit:hop x3} [gasps] „Für MICH?“, rief der Hase und machte das überraschteste Gesicht im ganzen Wald. {all:face happy} {bee:go to rabbit} {squirrel:live hide-nut resume} Das Eichhörnchen holte sein Geschenk hervor: seine allerbeste Haselnuss. {bee:live hum} Und die Biene summte ihm ein Geburtstagsständchen. {rabbit:tint #FFC0D0} [playfully] Dem Hasen wurden die großen Ohren ganz rosa. Diese Ohren hatten alles gehört. Aber verraten haben sie nichts.

fr-FR.title: Lapin entend une surprise
fr-FR.text: {rabbit:enter} Lapin avait les plus grandes oreilles du pré. Un matin, {rabbit:face surprised} {rabbit:live listen hold} elles se sont dressées d’un coup. Tout au bout du pré, quelqu’un chuchotait. [whispers] « Chut ! Cet après-midi, surprise d’anniversaire pour Lapin. Ne dites rien ! » Une surprise ? Pour LUI ? Lapin aurait pu crier : « Je vous ai entendus ! » Mais non. {rabbit:live listen resume} Il a juste grignoté son trèfle. Toute la journée, ses amis ont eu un drôle d’air. {squirrel:enter} {squirrel:go to rabbit} Écureuil est passé en bondissant et {squirrel:live hide-nut hold} a caché quelque chose derrière son dos, l’air de rien. {bee:enter} {bee:go to rabbit} {sfx:buzz} Abeille est passée en bourdonnant, {bee:face surprised} {bee:shake} a vu Lapin… et {bee:go away} a filé en pouffant de rire. [giggles] {rabbit:face happy} Lapin n’a rien dit. L’après-midi, {raccoon:enter} {raccoon:go to rabbit} Raton laveur s’est approché à pas de velours. {raccoon:face happy} {raccoon:live peekaboo} Il s’est caché les yeux… il a jeté un œil… {canvas:confetti} {sfx:popper} [excited] « SURPRISE ! » {bee:go back} {rabbit:face surprised} {rabbit:hop x3} [gasps] « Pour MOI ? » s’est écrié Lapin, avec la tête la plus étonnée de toute la forêt. {all:face happy} {bee:go to rabbit} {squirrel:live hide-nut resume} Écureuil a sorti son cadeau : sa plus belle noisette. {bee:live hum} Et Abeille a fredonné « Joyeux anniversaire ». {rabbit:tint #FFC0D0} [playfully] Les grandes oreilles de Lapin sont devenues toutes roses. Ces oreilles-là avaient tout entendu. Mais elles ont bien gardé le secret.

it-IT.title: Coniglio e la sorpresa
it-IT.text: {rabbit:enter} Coniglio aveva le orecchie più grandi del prato. Una mattina, {rabbit:face surprised} {rabbit:live listen hold} gli si sono drizzate di colpo. Laggiù, in fondo al prato, qualcuno bisbigliava. [whispers] «Ssst! Oggi pomeriggio, sorpresa di compleanno per Coniglio. Acqua in bocca!» Una sorpresa? Per LUI? Coniglio avrebbe potuto gridare: «Vi ho sentiti!» Ma non l'ha fatto. {rabbit:live listen resume} Ha continuato a sgranocchiare il suo trifoglio. Per tutto il giorno, i suoi amici hanno fatto i misteriosi. {squirrel:enter} {squirrel:go to rabbit} Scoiattolo è passato saltellando e {squirrel:live hide-nut hold} ha nascosto qualcosa dietro la schiena, con l'aria più innocente del mondo. {bee:enter} {bee:go to rabbit} {sfx:buzz} Ape è passata ronzando, {bee:face surprised} {bee:shake} ha visto Coniglio… e {bee:go away} è sfrecciata via, ridacchiando. [giggles] {rabbit:face happy} Coniglio non ha fiatato. Nel pomeriggio, {raccoon:enter} {raccoon:go to rabbit} Procione si è avvicinato in punta di piedi. {raccoon:face happy} {raccoon:live peekaboo} Si è coperto gli occhi… ha sbirciato… {canvas:confetti} {sfx:popper} [excited] «SORPRESA!» {bee:go back} {rabbit:face surprised} {rabbit:hop x3} [gasps] «Per ME?» ha esclamato Coniglio, con la faccia più sorpresa di tutto il bosco. {all:face happy} {bee:go to rabbit} {squirrel:live hide-nut resume} Ed ecco il regalo di Scoiattolo: la sua nocciola più bella. {bee:live hum} E Ape ha canticchiato «Tanti auguri a te». {rabbit:tint #FFC0D0} [playfully] Le grandi orecchie di Coniglio sono diventate rosa. Quelle orecchie avevano sentito tutto. Ma non l'hanno mai detto a nessuno.

zh-TW.title: 兔子聽到一個驚喜
zh-TW.text: {rabbit:enter}兔子的耳朵，是整片草地上最大的。有一天早上，{rabbit:face surprised}{rabbit:live listen hold}牠的耳朵咻地豎了起來。遠遠的，有人在說悄悄話。[whispers]「噓！今天下午，要給兔子一個生日驚喜。不能說喔！」 驚喜？要送給牠的？兔子本來可以大喊：「我聽到了！」 可是牠沒有。{rabbit:live listen resume}牠只是繼續啃三葉草。一整天，朋友們都怪怪的。{squirrel:enter}{squirrel:go to rabbit}松鼠蹦蹦跳跳地經過，{squirrel:live hide-nut hold}把東西藏在背後，一副沒事的樣子。{bee:enter}{bee:go to rabbit}{sfx:buzz}蜜蜂嗡嗡嗡地飛過來，{bee:face surprised}{bee:shake}一看到兔子……就{bee:go away}咻地飛走，咯咯偷笑。[giggles]{rabbit:face happy}兔子一句話也沒說。到了下午，{raccoon:enter}{raccoon:go to rabbit}浣熊躡手躡腳地走過來。{raccoon:face happy}{raccoon:live peekaboo}牠蒙住眼睛……偷看一下……{canvas:confetti}{sfx:popper}[excited]「驚喜！」 {bee:go back}{rabbit:face surprised}{rabbit:hop x3}[gasps]「給我的？」 兔子大叫，臉上是全森林最驚訝的表情。{all:face happy}{bee:go to rabbit}{squirrel:live hide-nut resume}松鼠拿出禮物：牠最好最好的一顆榛果。{bee:live hum}蜜蜂也哼起生日快樂歌。{rabbit:tint #FFC0D0}[playfully]兔子的大耳朵，變得粉紅粉紅的。那對耳朵什麼都聽到了，可是一個字也沒說。

zh-HK.title: 兔子的大耳朵
zh-HK.text: {rabbit:enter}兔子的耳朵，是全草地最大的。有一天早上，{rabbit:face surprised}{rabbit:live listen hold}牠的耳朵一下子豎得直直的。草地的另一邊，有人在說悄悄話。[whispers]「噓！今日下晝，同兔子搞個生日驚喜。唔好話畀佢知呀！」 驚喜？送給牠的？兔子本來可以大叫：「我聽到喇！」 可是牠沒有。{rabbit:live listen resume}牠只是繼續吃牠的三葉草。一整天，朋友們都怪怪的。{squirrel:enter}{squirrel:go to rabbit}松鼠一蹦一跳地經過，{squirrel:live hide-nut hold}把甚麼東西藏在背後，裝出一副若無其事的樣子。{bee:enter}{bee:go to rabbit}{sfx:buzz}蜜蜂嗡嗡嗡地飛過，{bee:face surprised}{bee:shake}一看見兔子……就{bee:go away}嗖一聲飛走了，還偷偷地笑。[giggles]{rabbit:face happy}兔子一句話也沒有說。到了下午，{raccoon:enter}{raccoon:go to rabbit}浣熊輕手輕腳地走過來。{raccoon:face happy}{raccoon:live peekaboo}牠掩住眼睛……再偷偷一看……{canvas:confetti}{sfx:popper}[excited]「驚喜！」 {bee:go back}{rabbit:face surprised}{rabbit:hop x3}[gasps]「係畀我嘅？」 兔子大叫，臉上是全森林最驚訝的表情。{all:face happy}{bee:go to rabbit}{squirrel:live hide-nut resume}松鼠拿出禮物：牠最好最好的一顆榛子。{bee:live hum}蜜蜂也哼起生日歌。{rabbit:tint #FFC0D0}[playfully]兔子那對大耳朵，一下子變成粉紅色。那對耳朵甚麼都聽到了，卻從來沒有說出去。

buzz.prompt: a bee buzzing quickly past, close, realistic

popper.prompt: a soft party popper pop with a little shower of paper confetti, playful
